import sys

def scan_word(ch, n, start):
    count = 0
    j = start
    while True:
        if ch[j] != '_' and ch[j] != '(':
            count += 1
        if ch[j] == '_' or ch[j] == '(' or j == n - 1:
            return (j, count)
        j += 1

def scan_inside(ch, n, start, counter):
    count = 0
    j = start
    while True:
        if j >= n:
            return start
        if (ch[j] == '_' or ch[j] == ')') and count > 0:
            counter[0] += 1
            count = 0
        if ch[j] == ')':
            return j
        if ch[j] != '_' and ch[j] != '(':
            count += 1
        j += 1

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    x = data[1]
    ch = x
    max_len = 0
    countw = 0
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        if ch[i] != '_' and ch[i] != '(':
            r = scan_word(ch, n, i)
            max_len = max(max_len, r[1])
            i = r[0]
        if ch[i] == '(':
            add = [0]
            i = scan_inside(ch, n, i, add)
            countw += add[0]
        i += 1
    print(f"{max_len} {countw}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
